title: Replace trivial BAM record leaves (bam_copy1, bam_endpos, bam_aux_append, bam_aux_del) with pure Rust
description: Replace 4 simple BAM record FFI functions: bam_copy1 (9 lines, memcpy), bam_endpos (6 lines, CIGAR arithmetic), bam_aux_append (30 lines, buffer append), bam_aux_del (5 lines, tag deletion). All are leaves with no hts-sys dependencies. Used in src/bam/record.rs and src/bam/ext.rs. Complexity: trivial-easy.
